name: comma-before-capital-sentence-boundary

name: comma-spam-five-words
note: Whisper inserts comma at every speech pause. Run of 3+ consecutive comma-words should collapse.

name: trailing-comma-becomes-period
note: Whisper sometimes ends an utterance with comma instead of period when speaker trails off.

name: trailing-comma-with-space
note: Trailing comma followed by whitespace should still become a period.

name: legit-comma-lowercase-stays
note: Comma followed by lowercase is a real comma — don't touch.
input: She said hello, but he didn't answer
expected: She said hello, but he didn't answer

name: spoken-comma-after-punct-hybrid
note: Hybrid mode: 'comma' word becomes ',' only when whisper signaled a break.

name: known-limitation-comma-before-name
note: Aggressive comma→period rule converts 'Hello, Michael' to 'Hello. Michael' (false positive). Documented tradeoff per v1.2.10 design choice.

name: abbreviation-period-stays
note: Sanity: existing periods in abbreviations should not be disturbed.

name: off-mode-passthrough
note: When mode is off, post-processor should not run.
